method: Supabase read-only list_tables (verbose; public and storage), list_migrations, pg_constraint/pg_policies catalog SQL, storage bucket metadata; no row contents or storage objects retrieved.

columns.name: owner
columns.comment: Field is deprecated, use owner_id instead

columns.name: owner
columns.comment: Field is deprecated, use owner_id instead

columns.name: tenant_id
columns.comment: Tenant scope. NULL only for Super Admin (cross-tenant support).

columns.name: map_polygon
columns.comment: Relative percentage coordinates for the interactive lot map visualizer. Array of {x,y} points; [] = unmapped.

columns.name: tier_key
columns.comment: Denormalized lot_tiers.tier_key for fast embed reads (no strict FK; catalogue is source of truth). NULL = unclassified legacy lot.

columns.name: is_corner
columns.comment: Corner lot: adds lot_tiers.corner_premium_cents to the effective price.

columns.name: price_override_cents
columns.comment: Per-lot price override in cents. Wins over the tier formula when set.

columns.name: geometry_source
columns.comment: How map_polygon was produced: manual draw, raster-auto ingest, or cad import.

columns.name: confidence
columns.comment: Detector confidence 0..1 for auto-ingested polygons. Admin-only; never public.

columns.name: needs_review
columns.comment: QA flag for low-confidence polygons. Admin-only; never public.

columns.name: masterplan_version_id
columns.comment: Map version the polygon was aligned against. NULL = legacy/unversioned (always publicly visible).

columns.name: project_id
columns.comment: Owning project; NULL = legacy unassigned rows, shown under the default project.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Contract lifecycle status. Phase B uses active, voided, cancelled, and archived without changing payment or collections calculations.

columns.name: void_reason
columns.comment: Staff-entered reason for voiding a contract. Voiding keeps the contract in history.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: Lifecycle: posted (live), needs_review (auto-ingested, excluded from balances until staff approve), voided, reversed.

columns.name: parsed_metadata
columns.comment: Raw structured JSON returned by Gemini Vision OCR for this receipt/proof. Never stores secrets.

columns.name: ai_confidence
columns.comment: Vision confidence 0.00-1.00. NULL when not machine-parsed.

columns.name: generated_status
columns.comment: Status captured when the Daily Brief item was generated; display must revalidate the live source record.

columns.name: destination_route
columns.comment: Safe internal route to the source record or filtered operational queue.

columns.name: possible_duplicate
columns.comment: Display-only duplicate review flag set when a linked application shares phone, email, or applicant name plus preferred lot with another lead/application.

columns.name: duplicate_reason
columns.comment: Display-only explanation for why a lead was flagged as a possible duplicate.

columns.name: duplicate_checked_at
columns.comment: Timestamp when lightweight duplicate detection last evaluated this lead.

columns.name: client_reference_id
columns.comment: Inquiry idempotency key (uuid per form open) for submit-public-inquiry retries. Unique per tenant.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.comment: Text identifier so audit events can reference both UUID and bigint-backed Wamule records without cross-table coupling.

columns.name: before_data
columns.comment: Optional minimal before-state JSON. Do not store secrets or full sensitive documents.

columns.name: after_data
columns.comment: Optional minimal after-state JSON. Do not store secrets or full sensitive documents.

columns.name: metadata
columns.comment: Optional contextual JSON. Do not store secrets or full sensitive documents.

columns.name: content_snapshot
columns.comment: Point-in-time company, project, lead, lot, pricing, plan, and topic content used to render the generated pack.

columns.name: inbound_alias
columns.comment: Unique inbound email alias for payment-proof ingestion, e.g. [redacted contact alias]

columns.name: masterplan_image_url
columns.comment: Public URL of the tenant aerial/site-map photo used as the ParcelMapCanvas background. Stored in the business-assets bucket.

columns.name: project_id
columns.comment: Owning project/phase. NULL is reserved for legacy tenant-level versions.

columns.name: preview_url
columns.comment: Optional mobile-capped rendition belonging to this exact map version.

columns.name: price_cents
columns.comment: Base price in cents (BZD). Public embeds show dollars.

columns.name: corner_premium_cents
columns.comment: Surcharge in cents for corner lots (parcels.is_corner).

columns.name: phase_id
columns.comment: NULL grants the member access to every phase in the project; otherwise access is limited to the named phase.
